mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 58 degrees. The night features a full moon, and we expect an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain predicted.

Construction is continuing on the Highway M project near the future Aldi site. Please note that from October 5 through October 7, a portion of the highway will be closed to allow for final paving work, with traffic detoured to Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. On September 29, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia and music at Paddy Mac's on September 30, along with the downtown farmer's market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local public safety, officers responded to a peculiar incident on September 5, where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields due to a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's of Verona has concluded its service for the evening after featuring the Turtle flavor. Tomorrow, they will reopen at 10:00 AM, and the flavor of the day will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
